Remove specified environmental states only in bounded footprint; does not dispel unit statuses or clear static walls.

Remove Wet/Burning from valid self/consenting recipient and create no field; basic dispel of these two tags only.
Up to3 observed-at-selection original-life targets; jumps require geometry, <=300cm; primary may be Wet for +20 damage; no stun.
Attackable60HP emitter for8000ms; radius250; allied aid-consenting bodies recover1MP/s; no damage/reaction/vision.
Interrupt and suppress one nonobjective construct for3000ms; does not disable service/trade/objective/tower or change ownership.
Pull self-owned or aid-consenting ordinary unit up to250cm by collision sweep. No enemy targeting, no barrier bypass immunity.
Apply100 barrier to self and currently aid-consenting observed recipients within300cm, once; no enduring passive aura.
